text.description_html:
Omnia 9537, 8mm Charlotte Metro Stainless Steel Cabinet Handle

Utilitarian in design, the Omnia made Charlotte Metro Cabinet Pull is great for both traditional and modern decors. The 5/16 Inch Diameter Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull is available in 3 lengths, all of which come in a brushed stainless steel finish. Made from the highest grade material available it is strong, durable, and resistant to corrosion and staining. The Charlotte Metro Stainless Steel Cabinet Handle comes packaged with installation hardware.

Specifications of the Charlotte Metro Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Available in 3 Sizes:

    9537/76
    • Length center to center: 3" (c.c.)
    • Overal Length: 3-3/8"
    • Projection: 1-3/16"
    • Pull Diameter: 8 mm

    9537/102
    • Length center to center: 4" (c.c.)
    • Overal Length: 4-3/8"
    • Projection: 1-3/16"
    • Pull Diameter: 8 mm

    9537/128
    • Length center to center: 5" (c.c.)
    • Overal Length: 5-3/8"
    • Projection: 1-3/16"
    • Pull Diameter: 8 mm

Sold Individually
